titulo: An auto shop's website, before and after
hooks: Do people have to zoom to call you?
The auto shop website nobody can read
From zooming in to a quote button
voz: A classic: the shop's website has tiny text on phones, the phone number is buried below and the map never loads. In the new version everything reads at a glance, it opens fast and the button to get a quote is always within reach.
captions: If someone has to zoom in to find your phone number, you've used up their patience before they even call.
A website built for phones reads without zooming, opens fast and keeps the contact button in view, even when you scroll all the way down.
Whoever's searching for a mechanic is usually stuck with a broken-down car and in a hurry. Give them your phone number, address and hours at first glance.
